subject: Turbine agreement
body:
Hi Ben,

Please take a look at the turbine agreement draft... I think we need the counterparty to confirm the delivery schedule. Can you check?

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Re: guaranty language
body:
Hi Suzanne,

The guaranty language looks fine because the parent company signs directly. However, we should confirm the governing law section.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Nominations for the capacity sale
body:
Hi Mark,

Attached is the draft nomination for the capacity sale. Please review the attached contract schedule and let me know if the process works for your team. Can you confirm by Thursday?

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Confidentiality agreement - Transwestern
body:
Hi Chris,

The confidentiality agreement from Transwestern is attached. The legal language is standard, however I would like our analysis of the risk section before we sign. Please advise.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: RE: ISDA master agreement
body:
Hi Sara,

Thanks for the ISDA master agreement redline. Because the counterparty is a foreign entity, we need the network of affiliates language tightened. I am attaching our process notes... let me know if you agree.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Summary of open legal issues
body:
Hi Ken,

A quick summary of the open legal issues: the agreement draft is with the counterparty, the guaranty is pending parent company approval, and the data room is nearly complete. I will send a full analysis on Friday.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Regulatory filing process
body:
Hi Jeff,

Please review the filing schedule for the regulatory process. The protocol requires the attached data before the hearing. Can your team confirm the server timeline? However, if the schedule slips we still have margin.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Turbine contract - counterparty comments
body:
Hi Tana,

The counterparty sent comments on the turbine contract... Their proposed changes to the delivery process create legal risk because the schedule is tied to the financing. I am drafting a response now.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Draft testimony - data request
body:
Hi Dick,

The draft testimony is attached. Please review the data appendix since the analysis changed after the last network model run. The legal review is complete.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Guaranty - final form
body:
Hi Liz,

The guaranty in final form is attached. The parent company signatory is confirmed and the governing law section now matches the master agreement. Can you route it for signature?

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Re: contract database
body:
Hi Steven,

The contract database is up to date through March. Because the server migration starts Monday, please download the reports you need before then... The analysis templates are in the shared folder.

Thanks,
Kay

subject: Meeting on the turbine schedule
body:
Hi Ben and Suzanne,

Can we meet Thursday to close the turbine schedule? The agreement process is otherwise complete and the counterparty is waiting on our legal confirmation. I attached the latest draft data.

Thanks,
Kay
